verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair question, but the evidence documents only a REST API, webhooks, an MCP server, and a Chrome extension. The note about adding Dover as an MCP server "from your terminal" describes configuring a third-party AI client, not a Dover-shipped CLI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
